injuries.name: Makai Lemon
injuries.shortComment: Lemon caught three of six targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The rookie wideout briefly exited Week 6 with an undisclosed injury but quickly returned and ended up running a team-high 45 routes on Tanner McKee's 49 dropbcks. It still didn't result in much production, as Lemon's six targets were a distant third on the team. The first-round wide receiver has just 18 catches for 127 yards and no touchdowns on 28 targets through six games. He can't be trusted as a fantasy starter headed into next Monday night's game against the Cowboys.

injuries.name: Dallas Goedert
injuries.shortComment: Goedert caught six of eight targets for 61 yards during Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: Goedert was able to reel in exactly six passes for the second straight week while his eight targets were second only to DeVonta Smith (14). With Jalen Hurts (calf) on injured reserve with a superficial blood clot, Tanner McKee took over at starting quarterback Sunday, logging 45 pass attempts in the defeat. If Philadelphia remains pass-heavy moving forward, Goedert will stand to continue seeing plenty of looks.

injuries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
injuries.shortComment: Wicks (undisclosed) returned to Sunday's contest versus the Panthers, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Both Wicks and fellow WR Makai Lemon (undisclosed) visited the medial tent in the second half, but both of them were able to rejoin Week 6 action.

injuries.name: Nolan Smith Jr.
injuries.shortComment: Smith (concussion) won't return to Sunday's game against Carolina.
injuries.longComment: Smith took a hit from Chuba Hubbard in the second quarter. He exited for an evaluation in the medical tent and was then escorted to the locker room by the training staff. With Smith ruled out for the remainder of Week 6, the Eagles will need to rely on Jonathan Greenard, Arnold Ebiketie and Keyshawn James-Newby to fill the void.

injuries.name: Carson Steele
injuries.shortComment: Steele is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a right shoulder injury.
injuries.longComment: Steele exited the first quarter, recording no carries and one four-yard reception before his departure. If Steele is unable to return, Jaydon Blue will be left as the only reserve option behind starting running back Dameon Pierce.

injuries.name: Drew Kendall
injuries.shortComment: Kendall (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: Kendall ended the week with consecutive limited practices. The center has recovered from his knee injury in time to suit up for Sunday's game.

injuries.name: Cole Payton
injuries.shortComment: Payton is active as the backup to starting quarterback Tanner McKee in Sunday's game against the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: A rookie fifth-round pick out of North Dakota State, Payton has yet to make his NFL debut, but he's one step closer to doing so after Jalen Hurts (calf) was placed on injured reserve Saturday. Payton had slotted third or fourth on the depth chart through the first five games of the season, but he'll be dressing as the No. 2 option while McKee draws his third career NFL start. Since he's set to become a free agent after the season and may not be viewed as the Eagles' long-term plan at the backup quarterback spot, McKee could be in danger of losing his grip on the starting job if he struggles in his extended snaps while Hurts remains out indefinitely. Payton could be someone to keep an eye on if the Eagles decide to give him a look at any point, as he displayed intriguing rushing skills during his collegiate career and gained 45 yards on three carries during his limited preseason action.

injuries.name: Tanner McKee
injuries.shortComment: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed Friday that McKee will start Sunday's game against the Panthers, NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.
injuries.longComment: McKee is likely headed for a multi-game run as the Eagles' starter, after Jalen Hurts (calf) was ruled out for Week 6 due to a superficial blood clot before landing on injured reserve Saturday. Rookie fifth-round pick Cole Payton is active as the No. 2 quarterback for Sunday's game behind McKee, who will be making the third start of his four-year career. Unlike Hurts, the 6-foot-6, 231-pound McKee is more of a traditional pocket passer who doesn't offer much of a threat as a runner, but he's been serviceable in directing the Philadelphia offense in his limited opportunities. He's completed 54 of 88 career pass attempts (61.4 percent) for 597 yards (6.8 YPA), five touchdowns and one interception.

injuries.name: AJ Epenesa
injuries.shortComment: Epenesa (back) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The decision comes as no surprise, given that Epenesa was listed as doubtful for Sunday's contest. He'll miss his first game of the season due to a back injury, and his next opportunity to play is Week 7 against the Cowboys on Monday, Oct. 26.

injuries.name: Hollywood Brown
injuries.shortComment: Brown (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: Brown missed the Eagles' last three games due to an ankle injury, but he avoided an injury designation for Week 6 after logging a full practice Friday. However, the veteran wide receiver will be a healthy scratch for Sunday's game as the Eagles go with six active wide receivers, with the position group led by a returning DeVonta Smith. Brown's next opportunity to play is Week 7 against the Cowboys on Monday, Oct. 26.

injuries.name: Joe Milton
injuries.shortComment: Milton (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Eagles' emergency third quarterback against the Panthers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: The Eagles signed Milton off the practice squad to the active roster Friday following the news that Jalen Hurts would be out indefinitely due to a superficial blood clot in his calf, with the latter being placed on injured reserve Saturday. The Eagles will start Tanner McKee on Sunday while rookie fifth-rounder Cole Payton serves as the backup. As the emergency QB3, Milton is prohibited from playing against Carolina unless both McKee and Payton leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.name: Jakorian Bennett
injuries.shortComment: Bennett (knee) won't come off injured reserve this weekend and has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 6 battle against Carolina.
injuries.longComment: Bennett hasn't yet played this season after hurting his knee during training camp. However, he had his 21-day practice window opened Wednesday and upgraded to full practice participation Friday following a pair of limited sessions, so the third-year cornerback could make his season debut next Monday against Dallas.

injuries.name: Landon Dickerson
injuries.shortComment: Dickerson (knee) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: Dickerson remains on injured reserve after he wasn't activated Saturday despite having his 21-day practice window opened earlier in the week. Willie Lampkin should make another start at left guard for the Eagles.

injuries.name: Eli Stowers
injuries.shortComment: The Eagles have downgraded Stowers (quadriceps) to out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: Stowers will have to wait at least another week before making his regular-season NFL debut after he had his 21-day practice window opened earlier this week. Stowers should see snaps as a catch-first tight end behind Dallas Goedert once he's ready to return to game action.

injuries.name: Grant Calcaterra
injuries.shortComment: The Eagles downgraded Calcaterra (back) to out Saturday for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: Calcaterra remains on injured reserve, though his 21-day practice window was opened earlier in the week. He's nearing a return, though his role is unclear behind Dallas Goedert and potentially even block-first TE Johnny Mundt.

injuries.name: Jaydon Blue
injuries.shortComment: The Eagles signed Blue off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
injuries.longComment: With Saquon Barkley (hamstring), Will Shipley (foot) and Tank Bigsby (abdomen) all injured and sidelined, Blue joins Dameon Pierce and Carson Steele as the Eagles' healthy running backs. Blue appeared in five games with Dallas as a rookie last regular season, rushing 38 times for 129 yards and a touchdown.

injuries.name: Zach Ertz
injuries.shortComment: Ertz is not being elevated from the practice squad for Sunday's matchup against Carolina, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: After being signed to the Eagles' practice squad Sept. 22, Ertz was elevated three straight weeks and produced a 3-22-0 receiving line on eight targets. However, he's reached the maximum with the three elevations and would need to be signed to Philadelphia's active roster in order to suit up again on game day. Ertz may no longer be needed due to Dallas Goedert returning to action in Week 5. Plus, Grant Calcaterra (back) and Eli Stowers (quadriceps), both of whom are still on IR, are on the verge of being activated.

injuries.name: Jalen Hurts
injuries.shortComment: The Eagles placed Hurts (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: After prior reports indicated that a stint on injured reserve wouldn't be necessary, Hurts will now go on IR after multiple consultations with doctors for the superficial blood clot in his calf. As a result of the transaction, Hurts will be required to miss at least four games, though the quarterback is out indefinitely and isn't a lock to be activated Week 11 when first eligible. Tanner McKee will step in as the Eagles' starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game against the Panthers, while rookie fifth-round pick Cole Payton will elevate into the backup role.

injuries.name: Jonathan Greenard
injuries.shortComment: Greenard (ankle) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against Carolina.
injuries.longComment: Greenard logged a full practice Friday, which was enough for the veteran edge rusher to be cleared to return from a one-game absence due to an ankle injury, and it's a timely return given that Jalyx Hunt (ankle/knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game. Greenard has one solo tackle and one forced fumble across two regular-season games.

injuries.name: Dameon Pierce
injuries.shortComment: Pierce will be the Eagles' starting running back against the Panthers on Sunday due to the absences of both Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and Will Shipley (foot, IR).
injuries.longComment: Shipley was placed on injured reserve Friday, and Barkley will miss a second consecutive game due to a hamstring injury that he sustained against the Rams in Week 4. As such, Pierce will be the lead back for Sunday's contest while Carson Steele operates as the backup. Pierce turned 11 carries into 14 yards and added two catches (on five targets) for minus-2 yards in a Week 5 loss to the Jaguars. That game in London was the fifth-year pro's debut with the Eagles this season, and with another week of practice under his belt, Pierce will have the chance to produce against a Panthers defense that allows 156.5 rushing yards per game, which is second-most in the NFL, behind only the Cowboys (168.4).
